# 3D avatars (not included)

The optional 3D talking avatar (`showAvatar: true` in `web/config.js`) loads two GLB
models from this folder: `avatarsdk.glb` (male) and `brunette.glb` (female), the
sample avatars of the TalkingHead project. They are not shipped here because their
licenses (for example CC BY-NC 4.0) don't match this repository's Apache-2.0 terms.
Download them yourself from the TalkingHead project, or drop in your own
Ready Player Me compatible GLB files with those names. This folder's `*.glb` files
are git-ignored.
